annotations.title: Check Supabase SQL for row level security gaps

description: Reads Supabase SQL (migrations or a schema dump) as text and lists tables in exposed schemas without row level security, RLS with no policy, policies that allow everything or read user_metadata, policies without a role, write grants to anon, SECURITY DEFINER functions and views, new tables without a grant, and public storage buckets, each with SQL that fixes it. Use when someone asks whether their Supabase database is locked down, or before launching an app that uses Supabase. The SQL is never executed or stored; policy logic (who should see what) is not judged. Findings are in Hebrew.

sql.description: The SQL text: one or more migration files or a schema dump
